## Description

Opt-in pilot under clinical review on per-tenant flags; exit gate review with evidence for: 0 fabricated medicines/doses on the eval set; ≥ 80 % minor edits; 100 % consented recordings and tested decline path; trust survey and note-time comparison. Clinical safety reviewer signs R3. Journeys J1/J2 AI steps (A-02…A-05) turn green.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Evidence for all four exit criteria attached and confirmed.
- [ ] **AC2.** Kill switch per tenant verified before go-live.
- [ ] **AC3.** R3 release notes include evaluation report and exclusions (clip, earpiece assistant, mixed Arabic/Hindi/Malayalam notes).
- [ ] **AC4.** Playwright J1 (consent declined branch) and J2 (consent → sign) pass with a stubbed AI provider.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
